# App Store Review Skill

> An open-source, evidence-first App Store review workflow for Codex and Claude Code. The first pass is read-only. It does not guarantee Apple approval and is not affiliated with Apple Inc.

## Review modes

- Pre-submission audit: check an iOS or iPadOS project before upload.
- Rejection recovery: preserve Apple's message, investigate evidence, and draft a response.
- Human-craft audit: find generic, copied, unfinished, or weakly differentiated product choices.

- Website: https://elxmaj.github.io/app-store-review-skill/

- AI-built app guide: https://elxmaj.github.io/app-store-review-skill/guides/will-apple-reject-ai-built-apps/
- Apple App Review Guidelines: https://developer.apple.com/app-store/review/guidelines/

## Supported project types

Xcode, Expo, React Native, and Flutter projects. Repository checks are combined with explicit manual checks for App Store Connect state, release-build behavior, and context that source files cannot prove.
